# Policy enforcement in workspaces

This section provides an overview of how HCP Terraform enforces policies for configurations in workspace.

For general information about policies, policy sets, and policy frameworks, refer to the [Policy enforcement overview](/terraform/cloud-docs/policy-enforcement).

<!-- BEGIN: TFC:only name:pnp-callout -->
@include 'tfc-package-callouts/policies.mdx'
<!-- END: TFC:only name:pnp-callout -->

## Workspace-specific features

The following features are specific to viewing and managing policy enforcement in workspaces:

- View and override policy enforcement results in the workspace UI. Refer to [View policy results](/terraform/cloud-docs/workspaces/policy-enforcement/view-results) for more information. 
- Access detailed JSON output for Sentinel policies. Refer to [View Sentinel JSON results](/terraform/cloud-docs/workspaces/policy-enforcement/view-results/json) for more information.

## General policy documentation

For information about creating and managing policies that apply to both workspaces and Stacks, refer to the following topics:

- [Define policies](/terraform/cloud-docs/policy-enforcement/define-policies): Write custom policies using Terraform policy, Sentinel, or OPA
- [Create and manage policy sets](/terraform/cloud-docs/policy-enforcement/manage-policy-sets): Organize policies and configure their scope

## Policy enforcement for Stacks

For information about using policies with Stacks, refer to [Policy enforcement for Stacks](/terraform/cloud-docs/stacks/policy-enforcement).

## Workflow

The following workflows describe how to create and manage policies manually.

- [Version control system (VCS) policies](/terraform/cloud-docs/workspaces/policy-enforcement/manage-policy-sets/vcs)
- [HashiCorp-managed pre-written policies](/terraform/cloud-docs/workspaces/policy-enforcement/manage-policy-sets/pre-written) **[BETA]**

### Create a policy set using Version control system (VCS) policies

Add a policy configuration file to a repository in your version control system (VCS), add policies, then connect them to your organization. The policy configuration file format depends on your policy framework. Refer to the following topics for more information:

- [VCS setup for Terraform policy](/terraform/cloud-docs/workspaces/policy-enforcement/manage-policy-sets/vcs/terraform-policy-vcs)
- [Configure a Sentinel policy set with a VCS repository](/terraform/cloud-docs/workspaces/policy-enforcement/manage-policy-sets/vcs/sentinel-vcs)
- [Configure an OPA policy set with a VCS repository](/terraform/cloud-docs/workspaces/policy-enforcement/manage-policy-sets/vcs/opa-vcs)

You can manually write custom policies in Sentinel or OPA framework format, or implement pre-written Sentinel policies created and maintained by HashiCorp. Pre-written Sentinal policies enforce common standards, such as PCI DSS. Refer to [Pre-written policy repositories](/terraform/cloud-docs/workspaces/policy-enforcement/prewritten-repositories) for information about publicly available pre-written policies. For information about writing custom Sentinel policies, refer to the [Sentinel documentation](/sentinel).

You can apply policies globally or apply them to specific [projects](/terraform/cloud-docs/projects/manage) and workspaces. For each run in the selected workspaces, HCP Terraform checks the Terraform plan against the policy set. A policy set can only contain policies written in a single policy framework, but you can add Sentinel or OPA policy sets to the same workspace.

Although the UI allows you author and store policies in the application, we recommend storing policies in a VCS to implement a policy-as-code workflow, which ensures standardization, security, and auditability. You can also create policy sets programmatically using the API. Refer to [Managing Policy Sets](/terraform/cloud-docs/policy-enforcement/manage-policy-sets) for details.

### Create a policy set using HashiCorp-managed pre-written policies

HashiCorp provides a collection of curated policies available.

- [Pre-written policies for Terraform policy](/terraform/cloud-docs/workspaces/policy-enforcement/manage-policy-sets/pre-written/terraform-policy-pre-written)
- [Pre-written policies for Sentinel](/terraform/cloud-docs/workspaces/policy-enforcement/manage-policy-sets/pre-written/sentinel-pre-written)

Refer to [Pre-written policy library](/terraform/cloud-docs/workspaces/policy-enforcement/prewritten-library) for information about publicly available pre-written policies.

You can apply policies globally or apply them to specific [projects](/terraform/cloud-docs/projects/manage) and workspaces. For each run in the selected workspaces, HCP Terraform checks the Terraform plan against the policy set. A policy set can only contain policies written in a single policy framework, but you can add Sentinel or Terraform policy sets to the same workspace.

### Review policy results

The HCP Terraform UI displays policy results for each policy set you apply to the workspace. Depending on their [enforcement level](/terraform/cloud-docs/policy-enforcement/manage-policy-sets#policy-enforcement-levels), failed policies can stop the run. You can override failed policies with the right permissions.

Refer to [Policy Results](/terraform/cloud-docs/policy-enforcement/view-results) for details.
